title: Vayadhammasuttaṃ
text: 179 . Sāvatthinidānaṃ. Ekamantaṃ nisinno kho āyasmā rādho bhagavantaṃ etadavoca – ‘‘‘vayadhammo, vayadhammo’ti, bhante, vuccati. Katamo nu kho, bhante, vayadhammo’’ti? ‘‘Rūpaṃ kho, rādha, vayadhammo, vedanā vayadhammo, saññā vayadhammo, saṅkhārā vayadhammo, viññāṇaṃ vayadhammo . Evaṃ passaṃ…pe… nāparaṃ itthattāyāti pajānātī’’ti. Dasamaṃ.
